info.name: Mixcloud — Dracula | Blood Moon Gothic Night
info.description:
Mixcloud descends into a gothic Blood Moon night: a crimson moonlit castle
landscape glows behind translucent, near-black violet panels, while deep
burgundy controls, blood-red highlights, dusty pink accents and pale lavender
details transform the interface. Blackletter display headings and Cinzel-style
Gothic typography contrast with clear, readable track metadata and menus.
